content.title: 3D Systems (NYSE:DDD) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q3 Earnings, Stock Drops 10.9%
content.summary: 3D printing company 3D Systems (NYSE:DDD) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 19.2% year on year to $91.25 million. Next quarter’s revenue guidance of $99.46 million underwhelmed, coming in 0.8% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.08 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
